name: Wei Zhang
bio:
Wei Zhang's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly during his university days, studying materials engineering. A chance encounter with a local racing team ignited his passion for composite materials and their application in high-performance vehicles. After graduating, Wei honed his skills at a specialized composite manufacturing firm, working on projects ranging from aerospace components to high-end automotive parts. He joined Proton by Premotion three years ago, drawn by their commitment to innovation and their competitive spirit.

Wei is known for his meticulous approach to composite repair and fabrication. He believes in a hands-on approach, personally inspecting every component he works on. His ambition drives him to constantly seek out new techniques and materials to improve the performance and durability of the team's cars. While a strong team player, Wei also thrives on independent problem-solving, often disappearing into his workshop to develop innovative solutions to complex engineering challenges. His dedication and attention to detail have made him an invaluable asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part.
physical.description: Wei is of average height with a lean, wiry build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical sketches and calculations.
Has a habit of humming quietly while working on intricate repairs.
Drinks copious amounts of green tea throughout the day.
